coordinate_convention: LiDAR X forward, Y left, Z up; right-compose Rz(yaw) with original extrinsic independently at every level

metric_definitions.reprojection: L2 pixel displacement relative to baseline for the same original LiDAR IDs visible in both images
metric_definitions.association: Baseline point-bbox pairs retained in the same fixed 2D bbox; overlapping boxes counted separately
metric_definitions.out_of_frame: Baseline-visible point IDs invisible after drift / baseline-visible point IDs
metric_definitions.threshold_exceedance: Fraction of points visible in both images whose displacement exceeds 5, 10, or 20 px

known_limitations: MMDetection3D demo point cloud appears camera-FOV filtered
not object ownership verified by 3D ground truth
